items.q: How long does a city-to-city transfer take?
items.a: The duration depends on the distance between cities. For example, Dubai to Abu Dhabi takes approximately 1.5 hours, while Riyadh to Dammam takes around 4 hours. Your chauffeur will choose the most efficient route.

items.q: Can I make stops during my city-to-city journey?
items.a: Yes, you can request additional stops during your journey. Simply let us know your requirements when booking, or communicate with your chauffeur during the trip. Additional stops may incur extra charges.

items.q: What vehicles are available for long distance travel?
items.a: We offer Business Class sedans, First Class luxury sedans, and Business Van/SUV options for city-to-city travel. All vehicles are equipped with Wi-Fi, charging ports, and refreshments for your comfort.

items.q: Is there a maximum distance for city-to-city transfers?
items.a: We cover distances up to 500 km for a single booking. For longer distances, we can arrange multi-day transfers with overnight stops at premium hotels along the route.

items.q: Can I book a round trip?
items.a: Yes, round-trip bookings are available. You can schedule your return journey at the time of booking or arrange it later through our app or customer service.

items.q: What is the cancellation policy?
items.a: Free cancellation is available up to 24 hours before your scheduled pickup. Cancellations within 24 hours may incur a fee. Please check our terms for full details.

items.q: Do you provide child seats?
items.a: Yes, child seats are available upon request. Please mention your requirements when booking so we can ensure the appropriate seat is installed in your vehicle.

items.q: Are your prices fixed or metered?
items.a: All our city-to-city transfers have fixed prices. You'll see the exact fare when you book, with no hidden charges or surge pricing.

faq.q: How does booking and pricing work?
a: 1. Enter your pickup and drop-off locations to see a fixed price.
2. Choose your preferred service class and vehicle.
3. Select your pickup date and time.
4. Confirm your booking and receive instant confirmation.
5. Your chauffeur details will be sent to you before your ride.

faq.q: What happens if my flight is delayed?
a: We monitor all flights in real-time. If your flight is delayed, your chauffeur will automatically adjust the pickup time. You won't be charged extra for flight delays, and your chauffeur will be waiting when you land.

faq.q: Is meet and greet service included?

suppliers.metaTitle: Become an AB Fleet or Transport Supplier | AB
suppliers.metaDescription: Supply vehicles or chauffeurs to AB in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Qatar, or worldwide for our outbound clients. Requirements and how to apply.
suppliers.heroEyebrow: Suppliers and fleet partners • GCC and worldwide
suppliers.heroDescription: AB plans and runs ground transportation for companies, government entities, event organisers and travel partners across Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Qatar. When a programme needs more vehicles than our own fleet, we contract licensed operators to supply them. If you run buses, coaches, premium sedans, SUVs or vans, or employ licensed drivers, apply to join our approved supplier list. We also contract chauffeur and ground-transport companies worldwide to look after our clients travelling from the GCC and India to the rest of the world.

suppliers.dayTitle: What working with AB looks like
suppliers.dayJobOffer: Job offers: You receive job requests with date, vehicle class, route and rate. Accept or decline within the response window.
suppliers.dayBriefing: Briefing: Before each programme, you get the trip sheet, passenger details needed for the pickup and the on-site contact.
suppliers.dayOnTheDay: On the day: Drivers check in through the AB app. The Riyadh control room monitors trips live and is your single point of contact.
suppliers.dayStandards: Standards: AB-branded name boards and dress code where the client requires it. No subcontracting to a third party without written approval.
suppliers.dayAfterJob: After the job: Trip records are confirmed in the portal. You invoice once a month, or per programme for events, and we pay within [N] days.
suppliers.dayPerformance: Performance review: Each quarter we share your punctuality, vehicle condition and feedback scores, and agree any improvements.

suppliers.faqQ1: Is there a fee to register as an AB supplier?
suppliers.faqA1: No. Registration and onboarding are free.
suppliers.faqQ2: Do I have to work only for AB?
suppliers.faqA2: No. You can keep your own clients. On AB jobs, your vehicles and drivers follow AB's standards and do not solicit AB's clients.
suppliers.faqQ3: How much work can I expect?
suppliers.faqA3: It depends on your vehicle types, your city and the season. Demand peaks around major events and Umrah seasons, and suppliers with strong performance scores are offered work first.
suppliers.faqA4: Approved invoices are paid within [N] days by bank transfer to your registered company account.
suppliers.faqQ5: Can I apply as an individual driver with my own car?
suppliers.faqA5: This programme is for registered companies. Individual chauffeurs can apply through Careers.
suppliers.faqQ6: Which cities do you need suppliers in?
suppliers.faqA6: In the GCC, we contract suppliers in Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Makkah, Madinah, Al Ula, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Doha. Worldwide, we contract partners in the destinations our clients from the GCC and India travel to most, such as United Kingdom, France, Switzerland, Germany, Italy, United States, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Turkey, Egypt.
suppliers.faqQ7: My company is outside the GCC. Can I apply?
suppliers.faqA7: Yes. We contract chauffeur and ground-transport companies worldwide to serve our outbound clients. Apply through the same form; our contracting team handles international suppliers too.
